normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day- 8 Adult bikes- Lake views- Event friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Dixieland Delight is just that—a delightful 8-bedroom, 5-bathroom home tucked within a private, gated community in beloved Seagrove Beach. Boasting over 3,600 square feet of pet-friendly living space, this lakeside haven features a private pool, sitting spa, and multiple wet bars perfect for entertaining up to 18 guests. Visitors can spend sun-drenched days on the shore or explore scenic local trails by bike. This serene sanctuary sits where rare coastal dune lakes meet the pristine white sands of the Emerald Coast—only a 2-minute walk away!Step into the inviting entryway of this stunning 3-story home, where a cozy coastal charm welcomes guests to the peaceful first floor featuring 2 lovely guest bedrooms with king beds and a shared bathroom. Savor a refreshing drink from the wet bar before setting outside on the covered deck’s plush furniture. Unwind in the private pool or sitting spa, lounge on the sun chairs, or let the dog run around in this fenced-in area.Adorned with white shiplap walls and enriched by natural textures and colors, the second-floor great room truly serves as the heart of the home. Pops of Parrish blue add a vibrant yet calming touch to this cozy living space, featuring 2 plush sofas and an armchair. Recharge with a post-beach nap to the soothing sound of waves or cozy up for a family movie night. Beyond this is the traditional dining area with seating for 8, and a nearby breakfast bar seating 8 more. The gourmet kitchen's open layout and baby blue cabinetry create a seamless space for conversation while prepping meals on high-end appliances. An expansive island anchors the kitchen, offering additional built-in appliances and ample prep room. Soak in shimmering lake views from Adirondack chairs on the second-floor balcony before retiring to the 2 comfortable bunk rooms, each featuring twin-over-full beds and private bathrooms.Retreat to the third-floor primary bedroom, a peaceful sanctuary complete with a king bed, a private bathroom with a deep soaking tub, and balcony access with sweeping views. This level also hosts 3 additional guest bedrooms with king beds and a shared bathroom with a shower.Dixieland Delight offers a serene getaway for lake and beach lovers alike! With on-site parking for 5 vehicles and 8 complimentary adult bikes, it’s easy to explore the area. For beach access, take a short scenic stroll to Walton Dunes Beach! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs, for an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax. *Parties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by the management company. Fees apply. Please contact us for additional details.

Boasting over 3,600 square feet of pet-friendly living space, this lakeside haven features a private pool, sitting spa, and multiple wet bars perfect for entertaining up to 18 guests. Visitors can spend sun-drenched days on the shore or explore scenic local trails by bike. This serene sanctuary sits where rare coastal dune lakes meet the pristine white sands of the Emerald Coast—only a 2-minute walk away! Pops of Parrish blue add a vibrant yet calming touch to this cozy living space, featuring 2 plush sofas and an armchair. Recharge with a post-beach nap to the soothing sound of waves or cozy up for a family movie night. An expansive island anchors the kitchen, offering additional built-in appliances and ample prep room. Soak in shimmering lake views from Adirondack chairs on the second-floor balcony before retiring to the 2 comfortable bunk rooms, each featuring twin-over-full beds and private bathrooms. Retreat to the third-floor primary bedroom, a peaceful sanctuary complete with a king bed, a private bathroom with a deep soaking tub, and balcony access with sweeping views. This level also hosts 3 additional guest bedrooms with king beds and a shared bathroom with a shower. Dixieland Delight offers a serene getaway for lake and beach lovers alike! With on-site parking for 5 vehicles and 8 complimentary adult bikes, it’s easy to explore the area. For beach access, take a short scenic stroll to Walton Dunes Beach! Book now!
